DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum.

The description of pearly, umbilicated papules in the context of a daycare outbreak is classic for this viral infection. Since the patient is immunized against chickenpox and lacks systemic symptoms, the diagnosis is clear and supportive care is appropriate. No further tests are needed at this time.
